capabilities: Create flashcards in note formats (single-line, multi-line, cloze)
Organize decks with hierarchical tags or folder structure
Review due flashcards and rate recall
Mark whole notes for scheduled review
extras: Full usage documentation lives outside the README; community translations are supported; maintained by Stephen Mwangi (owner) and Kyle Klus (maintainer).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to schedule reviews of flashcards or notes to fight forgetting over time.
summary: Spaced repetition plugin that schedules flashcard and whole-note reviews using the FSRS or SM-2 algorithms inside notes.
